data.raw_text:
A woman in Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines, has been widely hailed as a hero (a "furmom hero") for rescuing her two pet dogs from a massive building fire before escaping the blaze herself.

The dramatic incident, which occurred on December 10, was captured in a viral video that shows the woman's bravery and calmness under pressure.

Key details of the rescue:
Prioritized pets- The woman was trapped on the upper floor as smoke intensified. Her primary concern was her "fur babies".
Safe delivery- From the building's balcony, she carefully dropped both dogs one by one to bystanders on the ground below, who safely caught them.
Personal escape- Only after ensuring her pets were safe did the woman climb over the railing and dangle from the edge. Firefighters, who had quickly responded to the scene, raised a ladder to assist her in a safe descent.

The video of the rescue has drawn millions of views online, with social media users praising her selflessness and unwavering devotion to her pets. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation by fire authorities.
